description: Java class DashboardEdgeProcessor handling edge RPC messages related to dashboards in Thingsboard platform, including processing incoming messages, converting edge events to downlink messages, and filtering customer assignments.

classes.name: DashboardEdgeProcessor
classes.description: Processor class for handling dashboard-related edge RPC messages, including processing incoming messages, converting events to downlink messages, and filtering customer assignments.

methods.name: processDashboardMsgFromEdge
methods.description: Processes incoming dashboard update messages from edge devices, handling creation, update, or deletion based on message type.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateDashboard
methods.description: Saves or updates a dashboard entity based on the received message and associates it with the edge.

methods.name: pushDashboardCreatedEventToRuleEngine
methods.description: Pushes a dashboard creation event to the rule engine after successful save or update.

methods.name: convertEdgeEventToDownlink
methods.description: Converts an edge event into a downlink message to be sent to the edge device, based on the event action.

methods.name: filterNonExistingCustomers
methods.description: Filters customer assignments to ensure only existing customers are assigned, considering current and new assignments.

methods.name: getEdgeEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of edge event this processor handles, which is DASHBOARD.
